name: press-depth-button
title: Press Depth Button
description: A tactile button with a stable hit area and a short, physical press state.

accessibility.notes: Uses a native button, preserves a stable hit area, exposes disabled and pressed states, and keeps a visible focus ring. Reduced motion removes travel while retaining color and border feedback.

performance.budget: CSS-only feedback; no listeners, timers, or continuous work.
